## Validation
- [ ] Lint/validation passes
- [ ] Docs and tests updated where needed

## Legal and security review (Beatrix)
- [ ] No Windows ISO/WIM or Microsoft binaries are included
- [ ] No activators, cracks, KMS, or license bypass
- [ ] Changes preserve Defender, UAC, SmartScreen, Store, Windows Update, WinRE and Xbox unless explicitly approved policy says otherwise
- [ ] Tweaks have risk, verification, and reversal documented
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or undisclosed telemetry; telemetry remains opt-in/off by default
- [ ] Third-party code/assets have compatible license and attribution
